$description: Semantic roles, light theme. Same role names as dark, warm cream values. Adding a role here without adding it to semantic.dark.json will fail the build.

surface.$description: The ladder inverts: the well behind cards is the most tinted plane and cards are pure white, so raised content still reads as lifted.

page.$description: Body, the content well behind cards

inert.$description: Chart grid, track fills, skeleton states

subtle.$description: Tint wash over an unknown surface: nav items, chips, zebra rows

content.$description: Four AA-passing steps is a squeeze on a tinted well, so the light ramp sits darker than Director ships today. See the style guide for the three deliberate deviations.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Exempt from AA per WCAG 1.4.3, and never the only signal that a control is off.

default.$description: Card and input edges, the default

accent.$description: Active tab underline, focused input, selected row rail

default.$description: Accent icons, borders, active nav indicators

hover.$description: Hover for accent icons and links

text.$description: Accent-coloured text and links. Shaded because the brand red reaches only 3.9:1 on white.

subtle.$description: Tinted background: active nav item, selected row

gradient.$description: The logo gradient. Marks and rules only, nothing on top of it.

gradient-fill.$description: The same arc at fill weight, for a gradient surface that carries text.

status.$description: Graphics and text darken in light mode; the fills stay the brand hues so a badge reads the same in both themes.

on-fill.$description: Dark label. White on brand green reaches only 2.4:1.

default.$description: Neutral grey. The brand has no blue.

shadow.$description: Whisper-quiet on cream. Elevation is carried by the surface ladder, not by drop shadows.

focus.$description: Focus ring. Never removed without a replacement.
